svg.title: SOC homelab network topology
svg.desc: Seven VLAN Proxmox homelab routed through OPNsense and an 8-port managed switch, with ports 1 and 2 mirrored from pve1 and pve2 uplinks to SPAN port 8 feeding Zeek. VLANs 10/20/30/40 (IT) plus VLAN 50 ICSNETWORK, VLAN 55 OTDMZ, and VLAN 60 BACNET for the GRFICSv2 Modbus OT lab and the BACnet/IP HVAC OT lab (Purdue L0–L2 + BAS supervisor). VLAN 20 also adds Security Onion (VM 320, pve3) as a second, license-free NSM/SIEM platform alongside Splunk — confirmed live 2026-08-19.
svg.text: Suricata IPS, inline on vtnet1 — EVE JSON syslog to 10.10.20.50:514/udp
Ports 1–3: pve trunk uplinks mirrored → Port 8 SPAN · Ports 6–7: mgmt PCs (VLAN 40)
